RST-297: nested variable expansion (#341)

Declared variable values ({{$uuid}} in @var request, @const, @global, @file)
now expand when referenced instead of rendering as literal text.

per execution so every reference to a variable sees one value, and
gated to authored sources so runtime data (captures, script vars, OSenv)
is never re-expanded and cannot inject templates.
